```{r}
#| label: libraries-data
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)

options(tinytable_quarto_disable_processing = FALSE)

# Wrapping in a data-qmd div is how tinytable gets Quarto to run cell
# content back through the markdown/citation processor (see format_tt(fn =
# div_it) below). & and " have to be escaped or they'd break out of the
# HTML attribute -- this matters more now that reading can hold a whole
# markdown file's worth of prose instead of just a short citation line.
div_it <- \(z) sprintf(
  '<div data-qmd="%s"></div>',
  z |> str_replace_all("&", "&amp;") |> str_replace_all('"', "&quot;")
)

# A `reading` cell that's a path to a file in readings/_*.md gets swapped for
# that file's contents, so longer readings can be written/edited as their
# own markdown file instead of as a multiline CSV cell.
inject_reading <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !str_detect(x, "^/readings/.*\\.md$")) {
    return(x)
  }
  path <- here::here(str_remove(x, "^/"))
  paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: schedule-table
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

schedule_raw <- read_csv(here::here("data/schedule.csv"))

schedule <- schedule_raw |>
  mutate(
    date = format(date, "%a, %b %e"),
    reading = map_chr(reading, inject_reading)
  )

schedule_nested <- schedule |>
  mutate(
    var_class = ifelse(
      !is.na(class),
      str_glue(
        '<a href="/class/{class}.html"><span class="fa-solid fa-lg">&#xe53d;</span></a>'
      ),
      str_glue(
        '<font color="#e9ecef"><span class="fa-solid fa-lg">&#xe53d;</span></font>'
      )
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    section,
    Date = date,
    Topic = title,
    `Reading (before class!)` = reading,
    Class = var_class
  ) |>
  nest(.by = section)

# Quarto reprocesses these raw HTML tables (to expand the citation divs
# inside cells), which rebuilds each <colgroup> as equal thirds, clobbering
# tinytable's own column widths. Patch it back here, since this <style>
# block survives that reprocessing even though the <table> tag itself gets
# rewritten.
schedule_css <- "
.tbl-schedule {
  table-layout: fixed !important;
}
.tbl-schedule colgroup col:nth-child(1) { width: 10% !important; }
.tbl-schedule colgroup col:nth-child(2) { width: 25% !important; }
.tbl-schedule colgroup col:nth-child(3) { width: 60% !important; }
.tbl-schedule colgroup col:nth-child(4) { width: 5% !important; }
"


show_table <- function(i) {
  cat("\n\n###", schedule_nested$section[[i]], "\n\n")

  tbl <- schedule_nested$data[[i]] |>
    tt(width = c(0.05, 0.3, 0.65, 0.05)) |>
    format_tt(j = 3, fn = div_it, output = "html") |>
    format_tt(j = 2, markdown = TRUE) |>
    format_tt(j = 4, markdown = TRUE) |>
    format_tt(replace = "") |>
    theme_html(class = "tbl-schedule table", css_rule = schedule_css)

  cat(knitr::knit_print(tbl))
}

walk(seq_len(nrow(schedule_nested)), show_table)
```
